name: write-lamp
description: A write lamp: blinks in the input field (in the title bar where there is none) when an agent writes outside: an MR or PR, a push, a deploy and infrastructure, a write to a database, an MCP with writes; a click shows who and what, with a jump to the session; at rest it stays gray, without blinking
why: You see at once that the fleet is about to change something outside, without opening each session. Only a signal: the agents are not stopped
